source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’d like to remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $1 to me, making the split:
$15 buy, $5 to me, $5 to affiliate, $5 to block prize pool.

This improves my bottom line while having minimal effect on sales.
It also makes the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even split between me and every community member, together with everyone having an equal chance at the never-ending $500 prizes, seems consistent with the project’s ethos.

value_updates.referral_ticket_copy: Each successful code-used mint gives the referrer one Small Block ticket, with more tickets providing more opportunities to win.
value_updates.pool_funding_copy: Every mint and secondary sale funds the remaining Small Block prize pool indefinitely.
value_updates.reward_delivery_copy: Commissions are sent automatically to the buyer's wallet; Small Block prize winners are shown on the Winners page, notified through dashboard and email, and receive the $500 prize directly in their wallet.
value_updates.anti_scam_copy: The model is single-level with verified source code on Basescan; each $15 primary mint allocates $5 to the founder, $5 to the affiliate, and $5 to the Small Block prize pool.
value_updates.no_referral_allocation_copy: When no referral code is entered, the commission and one Small Block prize ticket go to a randomly selected existing NFT holder.

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided → the $5 + tickets are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every referral awards you a Small Block prize ticket for the current block. More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draws
process_items.copy: Small Block: 5 × $500 awarded every 500 sales. (Sales = mint + secondary) Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click whenever you're ready.
